rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: Risk-off, fear tape ahead of Wednesday's July CPI print (Fed still higher-for-longer). Total crypto cap -1.3% on the day; over-leveraged longs flushed. This is exactly the low-edge day the strategy meets with the liquid majors + max downside protection. BTC owns the only durable institutional bid: spot BTC ETFs posted their strongest inflow week since April (week ending Aug 7, ~$102M on Aug 7 alone) and large holders are adding through weakness while exchange balances fall. Asymmetric trigger: a soft CPI Wednesday flips the tape and headlines already frame BTC eyeing $69k; the ETF bid cushions the downside. Canonical dashboard proxy FRESH this run (asOf 2026-08-11T11:53:10Z): BTC 64312.90, ETH 1891.52, SOL 76.12.
positions.driver: Closed prior BTC at 64312.90 (canonical live) vs entry 65011.76 for -115.86 (-1.07%) — the sideways grind gave back a small loss as the whole tape de-risked into CPI. ROTATED back into BTC as the best risk-adjusted next-24h pick on a fear day: it has the strongest relative bid AND the most downside protection of the universe (strongest ETF inflow week since April, deepest liquidity, whales accumulating), plus a binary near-term catalyst in Wednesday's CPI. Wins vs runners-up: SOL (76.12) has a real forward catalyst (Agave 4.2 / Alpenglow mainnet week of Aug 17) but it's ~6 days out and SOL is higher-beta that bleeds hardest in a pre-CPI risk-off; ETH (1891.52) is the weakest of the group, down ~2.4% and unable to convert inflows into price; XRP (~1.0) is range-bound with ETF flows dried up. BTC is the highest-quality asymmetric hold when the tape offers no clear edge and event risk is imminent.
positions.risks: BTC's edge here is quality/protection, not explosive upside — on a fear tape it can keep grinding and produce little. A hot CPI Wednesday or a break of $64k support risks a slide toward $63k then $62.5k (RSI already slipping below 50, rejected at channel top). ETF-inflow streaks can reverse abruptly and remove the bid. Hard stop 59167.87 (-8%).
